verdict.rationale: Superset supports sending follow-up feedback to a running or new agent session from PR diffs (superset-gh-2) and via the Design pane with element context (superset-gh-1), plus notification when an agent pauses for input (superset-docs-11) implying interactive continuation without restart. However, there's no dedicated documentation of a general 'send follow-up instruction mid-session' chat/steering mechanism analogous to a chat-based agent tool, and it's unclear if this applies to all agent types or just PR-review/design contexts. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on steering an arbitrary active CLI agent session with free-text follow-up instructions, independent/hands-on confirmation that mid-session steering works reliably across agent types.
